recipe.visualDefinition: A square black outer sleeve featuring a large circular die-cut window that reveals a cinematic night scene in a cobblestone alley. Inside the circle, a conductor in formal attire directs an unseen orchestra, while a woman in rock-inspired fashion stands in a doorway. The composition is framed by heavy metallic block lettering at the top and elegant white script at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The circular window acts as a lens into a narrative scene against a flat black void.
The conductor's baton creates a diagonal line leading toward the central music stand.
Contrast between the industrial metallic top text and the fluid calligraphic bottom text.
Warm yellow streetlights within the scene contrast with the cool blue-silver of the outer branding.
coreInvariants: High-contrast chiaroscuro lighting in the inner image
Black border framing the entire composition

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The conductor is the primary figure on the right, scaled to fill the height of the circle; the woman is secondary on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular die-cut window serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the heavy top logo, drop into the circular scene following the conductor's baton, and settle on the script at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The outer black square provides significant negative space, focusing all attention on the central circle and the two text blocks.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and yellow (streetlights and interior glow)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the background with high-value highlights on the figures and metallic text.

letterConstructionRules: Top text: Extra-bold, condensed, vertical proportions with internal metallic gradients.
Bottom text: High-contrast script with exaggerated flourishes and swashes on capital letters.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Top letters feature a 'shutter' or 'ribbed' horizontal texture effect.
Bottom script features interlocking descenders and elongated crossbars.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between industrial/masculine top text and elegant/feminine bottom script.

preserve: The ribbing texture on the top font
The circular framing of the central image

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure for the top logo.
Offers the required flourishes and formal elegance for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square black frame with a large circular cutout in the center. Inside the circle, show a cinematic night scene of a Victorian alleyway with cobblestones, a conductor in a tuxedo with a baton, and a woman in a leather skirt standing in a doorway under a streetlamp.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, metallic-textured, condensed block-letter logo in the top left corner. Add a centered, elegant white script title with long flourishes at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the central image contained strictly within a circle?
Does the top text have a metallic, ribbed texture?
Is the bottom text a high-contrast formal script?
Is the overall background solid black?

adjustableVariables: Specific metallic texture of the top logo
mustRedesign: Any specific band logos or trademarked symbols
Exact facial features of the individuals
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the circle is perfectly centered horizontally.
Check that the metallic gradient on the top text looks three-dimensional.
Verify that the script text does not touch the circular image.
Confirm the black background is deep and uniform.
recipe.reuseFormula: Square black frame + circular narrative window + industrial header + calligraphic footer.
